command:
set -euo pipefail; cd projects/kobra2-neo; uv run kobra-plot doctor; rm -rf /tmp/kobra-curve-job /tmp/kobra-text-job; uv run kobra-plot prepare samples/svg/curve-demo.svg -o /tmp/kobra-curve-job; uv run kobra-plot text 'MILEGO DNIA' -o /tmp/kobra-text-job; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
for p in [Path('/tmp/kobra-curve-job'), Path('/tmp/kobra-text-job')]:
    r=json.loads((p/'report.json').read_text())
    assert r['safety']['valid'] is True
    assert r['execution']['allowed'] is False
    g=(p/'output.gcode').read_text()
    for token in ['G28','G91','M104','M109','M140','M190',' E']:
        assert token not in g, (p, token)
    print(p.name, r['geometry']['polylines'], r['geometry']['points'], r['geometry']['output_bounds'])
PY
